decisions.reason: The air quality module leverages the firm's modular Bricklet system and sensor-integration knowledge, enabling it to interpret and act on early results.
As a direct replacement for an existing analog input module, it builds on well-established measurement expertise, so drop is very unlikely.
The CAN bus interface module fits the firm's core communication-interface competences, allowing effective learning and improvement.
CO2 sensing is adjacent to existing sensor integration capabilities and can benefit from external sensor partnerships, making it likely to remain.
